Name: Robin and Demetrius's Better Bed Discussion
Author: AirynS
Description:
A small mod that edits the reward event for the Robin’s Project special order so that while they still have differing views and Demetrius still misses some social cues, the event is kinder overall and Demetrius isn’t written as a caricature.

To install, simply extract the “[CP] Robin & Demetrius’s Better Bed Discussion” folder and drop it into your Mods folder.

This mod is i18n-compatible, so if anyone would like to translate it, please send me a copy of the translated default.json and I'll gladly add it with credit!
- Thanks to Herienseo for the Chinese translation!

For anyone who would like to see the new text before downloading, click on the spoiler box:
[spoiler]
[b]Robin: [/b]Voila! My newest creation. It's a deluxe four poster bed, crafted from the finest local hardwood.
[b]Demetrius[/b]: Um... Robin? Won't the grooves in the posts and bedhead collect dust? It seems like it would be difficult to keep clean.
[b]Robin[/b]: Think about the beauty they add though. It's worth the extra cleaning.
[b]Demetrius[/b]: Hmm, I see your point... But for anyone with allergies or breathing difficulties, it could be a safety hazard.
[b]Robin[/b]: That's true, but... Demetrius, can we focus on celebrating the achievement right now?

[b]Robin[/b]: Hey, [Player]... Come in. Check this out... It's the bed I was able to make thanks to all the wood you gathered.
[b]Robin[/b]: So, what do you think?

> [b]Player[/b]: It looks beautiful.
[b]Demetrius[/b]: I'm sorry, dear... I'm happy for you. I'll give you some space and we can talk about it later.
[b]Robin[/b]: Thanks, dear.

﻿> [b]Player[/b]: It looks hard to clean.
[b]Demetrius[/b]: It's an important point to consider.
[b]Robin[/b]: *sigh* Alright, I'll make a note in the sales description to be careful of dust. Anyway...

[b]Robin[/b]: Now that I have a prototype, I can start selling them in the shop. Hey... these might look good in your place, [Player]! What do you say... can we pencil you in for a half dozen?
[b]Maru[/b]: Mom!
[/spoiler]
